title: shell-runner command configuration
description: Configuration for the shell-runner MCP server. Every top-level key except 'defaults' and 'version' is a command group; every command entry in a group becomes one MCP tool named <group>__<slug-of-label>.

defaults.description: Fallbacks for all groups. Precedence: command > group > defaults > environment > built-in.

timeout.description: Default command timeout in seconds (built-in default: 120).

max_output.description: Default output truncation limit in characters (built-in default: 20000).

output_to.description: Opt-in raw output to a file. Disabled by default: file output can persist secrets a command prints. Nearest definition (command > group > defaults) wins wholesale.

env_inherit.description: When false, commands run only with the declared env mappings (PATH and HOME still come from the parent so the shell keeps working).

outputTo.description: Opt-in raw output to a file. Disabled by default: file output can persist secrets a command prints. A string is a path written on every run; a mapping configures a directory the agent may write to when allow_agent is true. {command} and {group} placeholders expand.

oneOf.description: Disables file output (useful to override a broader setting).
Path written on every run, truncated per run. Owner-only permissions.

path.description: Path written on every run. Mutually exclusive with dir.

dir.description: Directory for agent-decided output files. Required with allow_agent.

allow_agent.description: Let the agent opt in per call with an output_to argument (true, or a strict filename).

append.description: Append across runs instead of truncating.

stderr.description: Capture stderr in addition to stdout.

description.description: What this group does; used in tool descriptions.

trigger.description: When the agent should use these tools; included verbatim in tool descriptions.

env.description: Environment variables propagated to every command in this group (command env overrides group env).

timeout.description: Default command timeout in seconds for this group.

cwd.description: Default working directory for this group (relative to the agent's working directory).

env_inherit.description: When false, commands in this group run only with the declared env mappings (PATH and HOME still come from the parent so the shell keeps working).

label.description: Short human-readable label; lowercased and slugged into the tool name.

command.description: The command line to run (runs through the shell; pipes and redirects work). May contain {name} placeholders filled by named arguments.

description.description: Refines the tool description beyond the group's.

args.description: Argument policy. Absent or false (the default): runs as-is, no arguments. true: free-form string list, shell-quoted, appended. List: named arguments, which fill {name} placeholders in cmd or are appended in declared order.

default.description: Value used when the caller omits this argument.

prefix.description: Literal text glued before the shell-quoted value, e.g. "--memory ". An omitted optional argument emits nothing.

suffix.description: Literal text glued after the shell-quoted value, e.g. ":rw".

env.description: Environment variables for this command only (overrides group env). Values may use ${VAR} to expand a variable from the parent environment.

env_inherit.description: When false, this command runs only with the declared env mappings (PATH and HOME still come from the parent so the shell keeps working).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for this command.

pipe.description: Second command that the first command's stdout is piped into; the tool result is its output. The exit code is always the first command's.

check.description: Automatic success check on stdout+stderr after every run. All present rules must pass; failure marks the tool result as an error.

read_only.description: MCP readOnlyHint: the command does not modify its environment.

destructive.description: MCP destructiveHint. Defaults to the inverse of read_only.

max_output.description: Output truncation limit in characters for this command.
